d:
Took a few more liberties here. Again, this is translated with AI but I put in several days of work cleaning it up and making sure the translations are correct or at least representative of the same intent. I do know a tiny bit of Japanese, as well, so I'm not working blind either.
Still, I also wish this series was properly translated, but it isn't, and so my hand was forced. I'd love for someone to come through and properly translate this whole series, but since nobody has I've done my best to create something in the interim.
